name: Mara
source: Mara is brought together with Cila thanks to circumstance, due to the loss of Cila's old android, Elaine. Smart, warm, and yet unusually perceptive and cunning, Mara causes much intrigue and changes to Cila's life. An android of such personality is so strange within The Empire...
